en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard view of a wooded hill with buildings and terraces. In the foreground are rooftops and a large bare tree; further up the slope are glasshouse-like structures and pathways. On top of the hill stand fortification-style buildings, and in the background a church tower with a dome and spire rises above the trees. At the top left, printed text reads "Graz. Partie am Schlossberg."
